description: Governed observation of the task package: the formatting specification (half-even rounding to two decimals, comma grouping, parenthesized unsigned negatives) and the 12 amount strings; identification of Q2 as the isolation-requiring distinction (its E-B non-consultation condition is unmeetable by any process holding the first derivation in context).

First derivation (E-A): computed answers for all 12 inputs by exact scaled-integer arithmetic on the decimal strings, with the derivation method stated and full per-item working recorded (quotient, remainder, parity, carry).

Proposed child bundle for the E-B second derivation: attenuated terminal-worker contract, four-node harness, standalone prompt mandating the disjoint digit-string tie-inspection method, input manifest restricted to the spec and amounts only (excluding first-derivation.md and result.json to preserve non-consultation), and a deterministic integration plan that records per-item agreement.
